canonical_statement: For every real normed space and extended-real-valued convex functional that never takes negative infinity, weak-topology lower semicontinuity is equivalent to norm-topology lower semicontinuity.
domain_and_universes: universe u; E : Type u; NormedAddCommGroup E; NormedSpace Real E; f : E -> EReal; proposition in Prop
hypotheses: forall x, f x != negative infinity
the extended-real Jensen inequality for all x, y and nonnegative real a, b with a + b = 1
conclusion: LowerSemicontinuous (f transported to WeakSpace Real E) iff LowerSemicontinuous f in the norm topology.

encoding_decisions.space: an arbitrary real normed space; completeness is not assumed
encoding_decisions.weak_topology: mathlib WeakSpace Real E, induced by the continuous dual
encoding_decisions.codomain: EReal, with negative infinity excluded and positive infinity retained
encoding_decisions.convexity: the explicit extended-real Jensen inequality because EReal has no SMul Real instance
encoding_decisions.semicontinuity: topological LowerSemicontinuous, not sequential lower semicontinuity
encoding_decisions.direction: an equivalence; norm-lsc to weak-lsc is substantive and the converse is retained

distinguished_by_separate_elaborated_dec: retained only the trivial weak-to-norm implication

degenerate_cases: The zero space, constant functionals, the identically positive-infinity functional, and empty sublevel sets remain in scope. Functionals taking negative infinity are explicitly excluded; properness is not strengthened by requiring a finite value.
